subject: maths
question: If the volume of a right circular cone of height 11 cm is 297π cm³, find the diameter of its base.
solution:
**Given:**

Volume (V) = 297π cm³

Height (h) = 11 cm

**Formula used:**

V = (1/3) π r² h

**Calculations:**

⇒ 297π = (1/3) π r² × 11

⇒ 297π = (11/3) π r²

⇒ 297 = (11/3) r²

⇒ r² = (297 × 3)/11

⇒ r² = 81

⇒ r = 9 cm

Diameter = 2r = 2 × 9 = 18 cm

**∴ The diameter of the base = 18 cm.**
